reference_label: Frozen pre-v4 archive: accepted v3 compact-search implementation
timing_policy: Persistent isolated public-API workers, alternating variant order per round; synchronized NumPy-to-NumPy calls; every call audited outside its timer. Three fixed-count warmups and nine measured samples by default; no duration warmup.
fit_query_policy: Fresh estimator fit plus first query, including deferred preparation.
cold_policy: First fit/query for each shape/distribution in its persistent worker after imports; prior distributions may populate compilation caches. Recorded separately from retained samples.
accuracy_reference: Exhaustive direct float64 subtraction and squared-sum distance over every training row on the serialized float32 inputs, with full (distance,index) lexicographic ordering. Query blocks of four bound temporary memory; no Gram selection is used.
